high_level_description: The image shows a person holding a box of Varicella vaccine, specifically the brand "VARIPED." The box is white with green accents and contains detailed information about the product. The text on the box indicates that it is a live attenuated Oka/Merck Varicella Virus vaccine, with each dose containing 1350 PFU (Plaque Forming Units). The packaging also includes a warning label stating that the product should be sold only by retail on the prescription of a registered medical practitioner. In the background, there are several other items on a wooden surface.
